questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde besøgt en ven i Glasgow tidligere og syntes rigtig godt om byen. Derudover virkede skolen til at have gode fag.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Relativt nemt hvis man tog sig tiden til at læse de informationer skolen sendte ud inden

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var nogle introforelæsninger

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Der er flere forskellige typer af boliger/kollegier. Både med og uden delt køkken/toilet/bad. Jeg boede selv i en en-suite i Kelvin Court (ca. 15 min fra campus) og delte køkken med 5 andre udvekslingsstuderende.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Tror nogle steder havde catering, men ellers havde de fleste steder vidst delt køkken.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer:
Mange af dem du kommer til at bo med er meget unge og har ikke prøvet at bo ude før, hvilket kan mærkes. Det var heldigvis ikke slemt der hvor jeg boede, men hvis du er vant til at bo alene, eller med et par roomies skal du nok forberede dig på en mindre rent køkken end hvad du er vant til. 

Derudover bør du for alt i verden undgå at søge om at bo i Murano. Det er slidt, man deler både køkken, bad og toilet og det er festkollegiet + ligger relativt langt fra campus

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det var meget meget dyrt. Jeg betalte omkring 41.500 kr at bo et semester

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Generelt er processen meget lang og kommer i steps

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Der var en mail man kunne skrive til. De var meget hjælpsomme og svarede hurtigt!

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik de fag jeg søgte, og fik også ændret et fag til et andet.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Læs informationen som skolen sender godt igennem. Det gør hele processen meget nemmere. De kan godt være lidt sent ude med at allokere fag, men du skal nok få dem, så ik stress over det. Du skal også være obs på at det kun er visse fag de tilbyder udvekslingsstuderende - du kan finde en folder på UofG's hjemmeside, men mener også de sender den til dig. Derudover obs på at skolen ikke tilbyder kandidatfag, men bacheloren er 4-årig, så 4 års fag svarer ca til kandidatniveau (ihvertfald officielt, jeg fandt niveauet meget lavere end KU's)

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Generelt er niveauet noget lavere end på KU. Man studerer heller ikke statskundskab som sådan, men politics, hvilket godt kan mærkes i den måde både elever og lærere tilgår undervisningen på.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Der er mere tradition for bare at sige sin mening, snarere end at komme med et akademisk funderet argument, hvilket havde fordele og ulemper.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
POLITIC4154 - Global Distributive Justice
POLITIC4102 - Politics, Communication & Democracy
POLITIC4161 - Protest Politics

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Klart Protest Politics. Det var lidt kaotisk sammensat, men undervisningen var mest bare en lang samtale mellem elever og underviseren, hvor vi snakkede man kan bekæmpe den ekstreme højrefløj og neoliberalismen. Meget spændende og givende.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Jeg skulle skifte mobil abonnement halvvejs. Det var dog billigere end mit eget herhjemme så det gik fint

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: At spise ude er meget billigere end i København. Madvarer var ca det samme. Togbilletter var ulovligt dyre

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er virkelig mange forskellige societies og klubber og meget af det sociale liv for de lokale studerende er forbundet til dem. Jeg var selv med i Håndboldklubben, hvilket var rigtigt sjovt. Deruover kender jeg en del der var i Mountaineering societien, som de virkelig var glade for!

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Vitterligt alt du kan forestille dig

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Generelt meld dig ind i en eller to societies/klubber der lyder sjove.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Rejs rundt i Skotland, og tag ud og vandre! Loch Lomond kan klares som en dagstur, og der er flere hikes rundt omkring, Ben Nevis er en kæmpe anbefaling, men en lang hike, så jeg ville anbefale en overnatning i Fort William. Derudover bør man klart tage til Isle of Skye.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt med de lokale. Skotsk humor minder meget om dansk humor. Det var lidt sværere med nogle af de andre udvekslingsstuderende (særligt de nord-amerikanske)

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Deltag i intro Ceilidh'en. Vitterligt der jeg mødte hele min vennegruppe

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Folk, både lokale og udvekslingsstuderende er generelt noget yngre (20-21 år), hvilket lidt er godt og ondt. Fik stadig nogle gode venner, men blev klart tættest med dem er var min egen alder..

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Pubkulturen er fantastisk. Der er simptelthen så mange skønne pubs rundt omkring. Og ellers bare den skotske kultur og måde at være på

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Tag på hikes, også hvis du ikke har hiket før og ikke tror det er noget for dig
Meld dig ind i klubber/societies
Vær forberedt på at folk er yngre end dig

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Tag på weekendture rundt i Skotland.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Det er skønt at bo og skabe et liv i en anden by. Jeg havde en masse skønne mennesker omkring mig, og fik en ny kærlighed til hiking og den skotske natur

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Folk er til tider en smule umodne. Men man kan sagtens holde sig udenom drama hvis man vil.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
